description: This file implements checkpoint and wakeup functions for process hibernation, managing process metadata and interfacing with a memory checkpointing system.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint of a process with specified PID, timeout, and data directories, storing metadata in provided storage.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Resumes a process from a checkpoint, freeing associated metadata and cleaning up storage.
